notes: force cases keep force.layoutAnimation at its default (true): the iteration steps on 16 ms timers, run by {frames} steps on a clock of their own
the default graph edge label text is the NODE value at the edge index (Line.ts: seriesModel.getRawValue(idx)), the edge name when that is null
sankey positions are local to the main group; corners / labels are through its transform

cases.note: layoutAnimation true (the default): the render shows the layout after the stage's step and the view's first; then a step every 16 ms -- 1, 5, 40 frames, then to rest
a drag while the iteration runs: no synchronous step -- the node is fixed where the drift put it, so it follows the pointer; the others settle around it a step a frame; a release unfixes it

a drag after the iteration stopped: the first move warms up and steps once synchronously with the node still free (the drift is overwritten), then fixes it where that step left it; the second move finds the iteration running and follows the pointer
roam true, zoom 1.6 by action while the iteration runs, then a drag: the drift through the roamed inverse
a graph on cartesian2d (layout none): Draggable drifts the symbol on the canvas, the drag handler writes the layout from it, simpleLayoutEdge and updateLayout follow
on cartesian2d, the series not draggable and node c draggable: c drags, a press on a does nothing
